open: Ask Professor Arth for a tip

tip.home: Pick up where you left off, or try something new. Every game here uses made-up money.
tip.learn: Short lessons first, then try the games. Each lesson takes a few minutes.
tip.lesson: Take the tasks in order. A wrong answer is fine. Read the hint and try again.
tip.simulations: These are real situations with pretend money. Make mistakes here, not in real life.
tip.minigames: Quick games on one idea each. Pick an easy one to start.
tip.safe: If a message makes you rush, stop. Real banks never ask for your PIN or OTP.
